{{Top|leg}}
'''Sunscreen oil''' was an [[Oil/Legends|oil]] used by beings who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to protect their skin from sunburns, which were common due to Tatooine's [[Binary star/Legends|two suns]] and [[Desert/Legends|desert]]-like climate.<ref name="Episode IV novelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode IV: ''A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>
